timeline.body: `Integer.MAX_VALUE` cannot be used as an array length, in many JVMs. Their max array lengths is some some constant close to but less than that. I've used `Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1000` in other projects. We should define a max capacity constant, and use it here and in `nextVariableIndex`.

reply.body: Yes, but the problem is how to decide the exact value of max array length, seems it's [VM-dependent](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3038392/do-java-arrays-have-a-maximum-size).
We can pick a conservative minimum that works for all targets. I think it's fine to waste a few slots on that. Trying to compute a value by inspecting the JVM would be too complicated, in my opinion.

Maybe we can take Java's `ArrayList` as reference, it choose `Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8` as the max array size. http://hg.openjdk.java.net/jdk7/jdk7/jdk/file/tip/src/share/classes/java/util/ArrayList.java#l190
Yeah, that sounds like a good choice.

timeline.message: Use Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8 as the max array size
